knowledge-access.description: Human access to the knowledge API. Full methods within /api/knowledge (principle 1) — and NOTHING else: the service's own read fan-out is the machine-only knowledge-internal role. Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py.

knowledge-internal.description: Machine-only role for the knowledge service account (azp=knowledge, client-credentials): GET-only sync reads of mail/search/agents. Never a human. Mirrors grants.py.

admin.description: Full access to every service (the single human principal today; agents' service accounts receive realm roles in Keycloak the same way)

internal-service.description: search/mcp service accounts: detached jobs continue under client credentials once the principal's token expires — leads API only. Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py's built-in default.

search-access.description: Human access to the search API + everything search DEPENDS ON to serve it. Full methods within /api/search (principle 1: every user sees the same data; the role gates API access, not rows). Search's function requires calling leads (Apollo/Mongo/Milvus for every result, similarity, hydration, enrich, credits), so this role also grants /api/leads — a role includes its service's dependencies (authorization is the Keycloak role; no policy bypass). The leads grant never widens direct browser access: leads has no browser route (only the anonymous webhook path) and caller_ok fences it to the search/mcp workloads, so it is reachable only via the search->leads exchange hop. Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py.

mail-access.description: Human access to the mail API. Full methods within /api/mail (principle 1). Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py.

jobs-access.description: Human access to the jobs API. Full methods within /api/jobs (principle 1). Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py.

agents-access.description: Human access to the agents API. Full methods within /api/agents (principle 1). Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py.

jobs-internal.description: Internal-jobs trust boundary: the ONLY role that may reach a producer's /internal/jobs/* endpoints (job-event stream reads + pause/resume/cancel control). Machine role held by the jobs client's SERVICE ACCOUNT (client-credentials, azp=jobs) — NOT a human; the acting human rides as audit metadata (X-FM-Acting-User). Scoped to /internal/jobs on the v1 producers search+agents only. Pairs with the jobs->search / jobs->agents exchange edges. Keep in sync with fm_runtime/grants.py.
